items.title: Broken toilet, emails down: The first 24 hours in space on Artemis II
items.description: The Orion capsule carrying four astronauts in NASA's Artemis II mission successfully fired its engines this morning, kicking the crew out of Earth's orbit and towards the moon.

items.title: Dockers claim thriller after Crow hits post inside final minute

items.title: Myanmar junta chief Min Aung Hlaing elected president

items.title: FIFA raises top ticket price for World Cup final to nearly $16,000
